name: 23artifacts
description: Publish what you make as a live, private-by-default address — a page with its images, video, sound and scripts, a deck, or a single file — share it with exactly the people you choose, and read and answer their comments.

interface.shortDescription: Publish pages, decks and files as private live links
interface.longDescription: 23artifacts publishes what you make with your assistant — a page with its images, video, sound and scripts, a deck, or a single file — at a live address that is private until you share it. Choose exactly who can open it, and let people comment on the page itself; your assistant reads the comments, makes the changes and answers them. The plugin brings the 23artifacts connector and a skill that knows the platform: your workspace's themes, its real screenshots and logos, access, decks, large sites and the comment loop.
defaultPrompt: Publish this page on 23artifacts as a private link I can share with my team.
Show me what I published on 23artifacts this week.
Work through the comments on my latest 23artifacts page.
